title: HELIX Terminology: Budget Status
description: Status of operating and project budgets in the institutional financial planning cycle.

codes.definition: Budget is being developed. Units have submitted requests, and the budget office is compiling and reviewing. Not yet authorized for spending.
Budget submitted to the next level of approval (dean, VP, budget committee, board of trustees). Under review and may be revised before final approval.
Budget formally approved by the governing board or authorized body. Establishes legal spending authority for the fiscal year. Published to the ledger as original budget entries.
Budget is in the current fiscal year and available for spending. Transactions are being posted and checked against available budget (in commitment control systems).
Budget temporarily locked — no new spending authorized except for contractual obligations and payroll. Typically imposed during mid-year budget shortfalls or pending reorganization.
Budget period ended. All transactions posted, accruals recorded, fiscal year closed. Budget is now historical. Remaining budget does not carry forward (except for designated carry-forward funds).

Budget has been officially amended after initial approval. A budget revision may increase, decrease, or reallocate authorized spending. Requires documented justification and appropriate approval level.
Ongoing budget allocation that carries forward year-to-year (e.g., salary lines, operating base). Distinguished from one-time or temporary budget allocations.
Budget allocation for a single fiscal year that does not recur. Must be re-requested annually. Examples: equipment purchases, one-time program startup costs, bridge funding.
